newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine July tax revenue up 15 pct - official.
newsitem.headline: Argentine July tax revenue up 15 pct - official.

text.p: Argentina's tax revenue in July rose by 15 percent from the same month a year earlier, the Economy Ministry said Wednesday.
In the first seven months of the year, tax revenue also rose 15 percent from the same period a year earlier.
"This is because of the improved economic situation and the effective fight against tax evasion," Jorge Sandulo, director of the DGI tax office, told journalists.
No figure was given for tax revenue in July, but in the same month a year ago it was $3.91 billion.
